objective: Implement contiguous float32 vector addition on a Pascal CUDA GPU, preserving reference correctness while reducing measured end-to-end latency.

inputs.x: contiguous CUDA float32 vector of length N
inputs.y: contiguous CUDA float32 vector of length N

operator_contract.output: CUDA float32 vector z of length N with z[i] = x[i] + y[i]
operator_contract.interface: torch.nn.Module Model, no constructor arguments, forward(x, y)

invariants: No CPU copies or hardcoded evaluation inputs
Support arbitrary N in the stated range
